title: Baked {p} Tostadas with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brush the {s} lightly with oil, lay on a baking sheet, and bake 8 to 10 minutes until crisp.
Cook the {p} in a hot skillet with the {spice} and salt, breaking it up, until browned and {doneness}.
Pile the {p} onto the crisp {s}, then top with the {v}.
Finish with the {sauce} and serve right away.
tip: Baking the shells instead of frying them keeps the crunch and drops a lot of oil.
